text:
incident-bot: PAGER: billing-metering anomaly detected — token-count delta > 20% for multiple accounts (prod). Alerting oncall.

oncall-alex: I'm paged, grabbing the runbook (billing -> token-drift). @billing-ops-john can you surface any ongoing deploys?

billing-ops-john: No deploys from billing. Seeing a steady upward bias from our emitter pipeline starting ~ 1710661000. Shadow tally is +28% vs ledger.

eng-sre-maya: Reproduced: emitter1 -> kafka -> aggregator shows duplicated batches. Suspect retry storm from proxy layer. Check logs:

eng-sre-maya: ```
2026-03-17T09:45:12Z emitter1 INFO tokens_emitted=1245678 window=60s
2026-03-17T09:45:13Z emitter1 WARN publish_retry=3 dup_detect=0
2026-03-17T09:46:10Z aggregator ERROR commit_timeout
```

eng-ml-sam: Not seeing model-side changes. This looks infra-level. Could explain token overcount and customer overage flags.

infra-nik: Rolling restart of proxy group p-emit-west (2/5) now to drain sticky connections. Will monitor for reduction in retries.

customer-success-rita: Heads up — a small set of customers got auto-overage emails. I'm pausing notifications for affected orgs (bank-of-orion, starlit-health) while we triage.

oncall-alex: Good call. Added suppression tag to alerting. Initiating mitigation checklist: 1) stop emitter retries 2) patch commit-timeouts 3) reconcile shadow ledger

billing-ops-john: Running quick SQL to check divergence:

billing-ops-john: ```sql
-- sum of emitted tokens vs ledger per customer
select c.customer_id, sum(emitted_tokens) as emiss, sum(ledger_tokens) as ledger
from token_emits e join ledgers l on e.customer_id = l.customer_id
where e.ts > (now() - interval '2 hour')
group by c.customer_id
order by (emiss - ledger) desc
limit 20;
```

billing-ops-john: Early result: bank-of-orion emiss=9,123,200 ledger=7,041,100 delta=2,082,100 (~29.6%)

eng-sre-maya: After restart, emitter retry_rate dropped from 11% -> 1.2% on p-emit-west. Monitoring dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/emit-retries

oncall-alex: Nice. Can we run a targeted backfill reconciliation for the 2hr window? We should avoid issuing customer refunds until we confirm which counts are true.

billing-ops-john: Starting backfill job recon-run-171066. ETA ~ 18m.

customer-success-rita: I'll hold customer comms — will update if backfill shows ledger should be corrected. If we need to credit, prepare draft template.

eng-ml-sam: For visibility — no model latency regressions. This was purely emitter duplication.

infra-nik: Patch pushed to proxy: lower retries and tighten commit timeouts. Will roll to remaining nodes in 5m.

oncall-alex: Summary so far: cause=proxy-induced retry storm -> emitter duplication; impact=~28% overcount for some customers; mitigation=restarts + proxy patch + backfill reconciliation + paused notifications. Owners: eng-sre (maya), infra (nik), billing (john), cs (rita).

oncall-alex: Marking thread as active. Update again in 10m or on major milestone. :thumbsup:

eng-sre-maya: Update 10m: retry rate stable ~0.9%, backfill job running 60% complete, no new overage emails sent.

billing-ops-john: Backfill finished. Reconciled ledger for affected customers; adjustments staged but not applied. Delta checks passed. Recommendation: apply corrections and issue credits to 6 affected accounts. Will await CS ok.

customer-success-rita: Approving credits for the 6 orgs. I'll draft emails and coordinate amounts with billing. Please tag me when corrections are applied.

eng-sre-maya: Corrections applied at 1710664380. Closing mitigation. Will follow up with postmortem link.

oncall-alex: Closing pager. Postmortem assigned to eng-sre-maya and infra-nik. Thank you everyone. :tada:
